headline: Tower Records Japan says an outside party got into its online shop and about 11 million records leaked; card data not included.
summary: First build from the company's own notice (Tier 1, read Nov 22), Nikkei and Investing.com (both relay the notice, so one source behind it). c001 unauthorised access Confirmed; c003 to c007 data and counts Confirmed from the notice; c008 and c009 Reported (company snapshot and plans). How they got in, who, and any link to other retailer incidents Not established. Nikkei read only in part (subscription). Privacy check done: no staff, officials or contacts named; help-desk links and phone details left out.
author: Research agent
